'''T'ra Saa's ship''' was a ship [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] used to fly to the [[Azurbani system]] on a mission given her by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to meet with [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and inform him of [[Volfe Karkko]]'s history. The ship was shot down by the [[Kiffu Guardians]] and crashed on [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], although Master Saa survived to complete her mission. It was later repaired by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] smuggler and friend of [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], who instead of fleeing Kiffex, returned and assisted the Jedi.<ref name="SW34" />
